The '''Great Cavern''' was a massive [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located in the [[Senol Forest]] on [[Innton II]]. The cave contained the [[Defiant Core]], a base made from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Recusant-class light destroyer|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] took over the cave and finished the construction of the Defiant Core.<ref name="Strongholds" />
